stories.headline: PM Ruginienė sparks controversy by remaining seated during Catholic mass
stories.summary: Prime Minister Inga Ruginienė caused public debate after sitting during portions of a Catholic mass commemorating the 1863-1864 uprising, while presidents and other officials stood or knelt. Her office explained she is not a practicing Catholic and was affected by incense.

stories.headline: Zelensky visits Lithuania for 1863-1864 uprising commemoration and bilateral talks
stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky visited Lithuania to commemorate the 1863-1864 uprising alongside Lithuanian and Polish presidents. Meetings with President Nausėda covered Ukraine's EU membership timeline, energy system support, and military cooperation. Nausėda emphasized Lithuania's continued support for Ukraine.

stories.headline: Danish King Frederik X conducts state visit to Lithuania
stories.summary: King Frederik X and Queen Mary of Denmark visited Lithuania for bilateral meetings with President Nausėda and Prime Minister Ruginienė. Discussions covered Arctic security, Ukraine, and Baltic-Nordic cooperation. A state dinner was held at the Presidential Palace.

stories.headline: Lithuania procures €210 million tank bridge systems from Germany
stories.summary: Lithuania signed a contract with KNDS Deutschland for 12 Leopard 2A8 Leguan armored vehicle launched bridges. Defense Minister Kaunas said the systems will significantly improve battlefield mobility and tactical flexibility for Lithuanian Armed Forces.

stories.headline: Lithuania delays Embraer C-390 military aircraft purchase until 2030
stories.summary: Lithuania postponed procurement of Brazilian-made Embraer C-390 military transport aircraft, citing priorities for air defense and new military infrastructure. The country will modernize its C-27J Spartan fleet instead and revisit aircraft procurement around 2030.

articles.title: Lithuania delays Embraer C-390 buy, modernizes Spartan fleet

stories.headline: Baltic states establish military mobility 'Schengen' area
stories.summary: Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania agreed to create a Baltic Military Mobility Area to allow easier troop movement between the three countries. Defense ministers signed a declaration removing peacetime bureaucratic barriers for military equipment and personnel transit.

articles.title: Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania establish a military mobility area
Baltic states agree to create military mobility 'Schengen' area

stories.headline: LRT public broadcaster reform discussions continue
stories.summary: Prime Minister Ruginienė said she wanted to join protests about press freedom but security advised against it. She called for broader public discussion of proposed reforms to Lithuanian National Radio and Television governance, acknowledging lessons from last year's controversies.

articles.title: I. Ruginienė apie LRT: pati norėjau dalyvauti proteste, bet apsauga atkalbėjo

stories.headline: US-Lithuania joint military exercise Unified Partners 26 concluded
stories.summary: US Army's 407th Civil Affairs Battalion and Lithuanian Riflemen's Union completed joint training exercise Unified Partners 26. The exercise marked a historic milestone as one of the first mounted training collaborations in over a century between the two forces.

articles.title: US Army, Lithuanian Forces strengthen partnership in joint training exercise Unified Partners 26

stories.headline: Ruginienė proposes banking fraud prevention measures
stories.summary: Prime Minister Ruginienė suggested banks should temporarily hold client transfers and return funds once fraud is confirmed. She said legislative changes are planned to give banks authority to reverse fraudulent transactions and protect customers from scams.

articles.title: Ruginienė turi idėją bankams, kaip užkirsti kelią sukčiams išvilioti pinigus

stories.headline: Defense procurement reforms not linked to corruption, PM says
stories.summary: Prime Minister Ruginienė stated that proposed changes to defense procurement procedures are not related to specific corruption cases, as none have been detected. She emphasized plans to reduce intermediaries and purchase directly from manufacturers for major acquisitions.

articles.title: Ruginienė: KAM viešųjų pirkimų tvarkos pokyčiai nesusiję su korupcija – tokių atvejų nefiksuota

stories.headline: Opposition demands detailed presentation of defense Plans B and C
stories.summary: Liberal Movement leader Viktorija Čmilytė-Nielsen said opposition parties are waiting for Prime Minister Ruginienė to present detailed Lithuanian defense plans B and C for scenarios if NATO dissolves. This follows the PM's previous statements about having contingency plans.

articles.title: Opozicija kviečia premjerę: lauks išsamaus planų B ir C pristatymo

stories.headline: President convenes State Defense Council meeting
stories.summary: President Nausėda called a State Defense Council meeting to discuss regional security, intelligence service strategies, the National Security Strategy project, transport aviation development, and other state defense matters.

articles.title: Nausėda šaukia Valstybės gynimo tarybos posėdį

stories.headline: Coalition to continue unless Social Democrats decide otherwise, PM says
stories.summary: Prime Minister Ruginienė said the governing coalition with Dawn of Nemunas will only end if the Social Democratic Party makes a collective decision to that effect, despite ongoing controversies about the junior partner's connections.

articles.title: Premjerė: koalicija nustos egzistuoti tik jei bus toks Socialdemokratų partijos sprendimas

stories.headline: PM responds to Cichanouskajas departure to Warsaw
stories.summary: Prime Minister Ruginienė responded calmly to Belarusian opposition leader Sviatlana Cichanouskajas office moving from Vilnius to Warsaw, saying she sees neither added value nor loss from the departure. She criticized former PM Skvernelis for suggesting this would open paths to improve relations with Belarus.

articles.title: Аtitrūko nuo realybės: premjerė sureagavo į Skvernelio pareiškimus dėl Cichanouskajos

stories.headline: Belarus balloons continue flying into Lithuania despite past agreements
stories.summary: Prime Minister Ruginienė noted that Belarusian balloons entering Lithuanian airspace continue as a mix of contraband and hybrid attacks, despite earlier US envoy claims that Lukashenko promised to stop the flights. The PM said balloons flew and will continue to fly.

articles.title: Premjerė apie balionus: spalį – kontrabanda, gruodį – hibridinė ataka, dabar – mišinys
